The problem

Nearest-neighbour expansion is cheap and it works — for two rounds. After that the frontier has travelled far enough that "nearest" no longer means "in the same domain", and your lexicon quietly stops describing what you started with. The fix is to score each candidate against the seed region, not just against its nearest neighbour.
